name: YOLO
summary: The agent runs every tool call without asking and without a policy check. Harnesses that default to permission modes expose it as an explicit opt-in, such as Claude Code's bypassPermissions mode and Codex's --yolo flag. Claude Code's docs say to use it only in isolated environments such as containers or VMs, and Codex's docs mark the flag as not recommended.
how: Start the harness with its bypass flag or mode
Every tool call runs without a prompt or rule check
Contain damage with a container, VM or throwaway machine instead
facts: Exposed as an opt-in mode in
Claude Code managed settings can disable bypass mode
No interruptions, but nothing stops a destructive or injected action
goodFor: Long unattended runs on throwaway machines
watchOut: Prompt injection goes straight to execution
Codex's flag also removes the sandbox, not just approvals
